comment:
* EapTtlsAvp represents the structure of an AVP during an EAP-TTLS session (RFC5281#10.1) The * structure of the flag byte is as follows: * * 
 * |---+---+---+---+---+-----------+
 * | 7 | 6 | 5 | 4 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 0 |
 * | V | M | r | r | r | r | r | r |
 * |---+---+---+---+---+---+---+---+
 * V = Vendor ID present
 * M = AVP support is mandatory
 * r = Reserved bits (must be ignored)
 *
* * @see RFC 5281, Extensible * Authentication Protocol Tunneled Transport Layer Security Authenticated Protocol Version 0 * (EAP-TTLSv0)

variables.name: EAP_MESSAGE_AVP_CODE
variables.comment: RFC 5281, section 10.1), as opposed to the one defined in RFC 3579.
